summary: Updating a processed or processing receipt clears all previously extracted data
failure_scenario: If a receipt is accidentally marked as PROCESSED, then later updated with review data via PATCH /receipts/{id}, all previously extracted data is lost

summary: Route GET /receipts/{receipt} points to non-existent show method
failure_scenario: Calling GET /receipts/{id} returns 500 error because show method doesn't exist (was renamed to file)

summary: Inefficient locking in confirm method - row lock occurs before checking if action should proceed
failure_scenario: Unnecessary database locking and fetching when receipt cannot be confirmed due to wrong state (not REQUIRES_REVIEW or already has movement_id)

summary: User registration not wrapped in transaction, risking inconsistent state if category creation fails
failure_scenario: If User::create succeeds but one of the category creation operations fails, the user is created without default categories
